# NevTan Reseller Program

> Resell NevTan Workspace to your clients at 10% off list price, with a $500 minimum order. Every NevTan Workspace plan includes NevTan Mail, Drive, Engage, Sign and Cloud; NevTan AI and Office are free for every client. You set your own prices and bill your clients directly.

## Pages

- [Home](https://reseller.nevtan.com/): The program at a glance — terms, the apps you can resell, who it's for and how it works.
- [Reseller pricing](https://reseller.nevtan.com/pricing): Live NevTan Workspace plans with the list price, the reseller price and an earnings calculator.
- [Products](https://reseller.nevtan.com/products): Every NevTan app you can resell, with a page for each.
- [How it works](https://reseller.nevtan.com/how-it-works): The five steps from applying to billing your own clients.
- [FAQ](https://reseller.nevtan.com/faq): Questions about the program, pricing, clients and products.
- [Apply](https://reseller.nevtan.com/apply): The application form. Applications are reviewed within one business day.
- [NevTan Workspace pricing](https://workspace.nevtan.com/pricing): The list prices the reseller discount applies to.
